fusions.name: Horned Brow
fusions.desc: Butts the target with a spiked brow that deals 14 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds, with a 50% chance of [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Ledge Collapse
fusions.desc: Kicks loose the ground you cling to; every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes a blow that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, with a 50% chance to be [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Claws in the Rock
fusions.desc: Digs your claws into the ground: your armour rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Stubborn Regrowth
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once and you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
